verdict.rationale: Obsidian's first-party Sync add-on documents version history that lets you view or restore previous versions of a note, which covers the core of the story. The evidence is only a one-line feature mention, and nothing covers recovering deleted notes. missing for 10: documented recovery of deleted notes, detail on how version history is viewed and restored (retention, UI), independent or hands-on corroboration, availability without the paid Sync add-on.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can view a note's version history and restore earlier versions or recover deleted notes

citations.quote: Version history - View or restore previous versions of a note.
Obsidian Sync is an add-on service that allows you to privately sync your notes across devices.
